evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and modifies fee estimation deserialization in src/policy/fees/block_policy_estimator.cpp.
rationale: Validates deserialized fee estimate buckets to prevent potential out-of-bounds reads if fee_estimates.dat is corrupted. As described by the author, omitting the terminal bucket causes lookups to read past the end of the bucket map, though triggering this requires a corrupted or tampered local data file.
